newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - March 31.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - March 31.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Riyadh governor Prince Salman opens an 82 million riyal road in Riyadh.
- Seven killed in floods caused by heavy rain in Saudi Arabia's southern province of Asir.
- Jeddah port to receive 92,050 haj pilgrims for the annual pilgrimage to Islam's holiest shrines starting next month. Around 5,000 pilgrims to arrive from France.
- Saudi Interior Minister Prince Nayef announces a training plan for Saudis.
- Saudi Arabian Airlines to take delivery in July of first MD11 aircraft.
